description: This file defines the ContentTranslationRouteSubscriber class, which extends RouteSubscriberBase to modify routing for content translation in Drupal. It adds routes for content translation overview, add, edit, and delete operations for entity types, and customizes route requirements.

classes.name: ContentTranslationRouteSubscriber
classes.description: A route subscriber that adds and alters routes related to content translation for entity types in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ContentTranslationManagerInterface dependency.

methods.name: alterRoutes
methods.description: Modifies route collection to add content translation routes for supported entity types, including overview, add, edit, delete, and custom access requirements.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the RoutingEvents::ALTER event with priority -210.
